protocol.experiment: Joint input-only zero ablation: L3-T1372 plus L28-T1123
protocol.scope: Two exact existing child prompts, uppercase and lowercase; only input child token 27 at each transform own layer; no generated-token edits.
protocol.intervention: Native MLP output[token 27] minus each selected current-trajectory estimated contribution. Recompute L28 standardized input, gate and UV output after L3 ablation. FP32 accumulation then one BF16 cast. Native attention and other positions unchanged.
protocol.scoring: Full greedy answers and separate cached teacher-forced native continuations. Uppercase P(CH) at first output; lowercase P( ch | native child:) at output step2. Also target-versus-CI/ci logit margins and log odds.
protocol.hypothesis: Two-feature combined necessity/redundancy pilot; changes in gate or confidence alone do not prove absorption or mechanistic cooperation.
protocol.controls: Unhooked native; zero-strength both-hook control; each single feature ablation; exact prior single-feature reproduction; independent CPU reconstruction of all edits and dynamic L28 input verification.
protocol.resources: Reuse retained SPAR instance56698356; no rental or lifecycle action.
